rule.description: An item-level function that reads one locally defined data type through at least four distinct zero-or-one-argument method calls, while not being hosted on that type, works almost entirely with the data of that other type.

checks.description: Detect reporting functions that reduce one storage family to its storage-shape summary while not being hosted on that family.
checks.detected_relation: free reporting function -> foreign array family
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The function exists only to interpret one family's members, so the data definition and its reader live apart and drift together through two-file edits.

matches.evidence: Reads StringArray through data(), offsets(), validity(), len(); every value it reports comes from the StringArray it receives.
Reads DecimalArray through decimal_type(), values(), validity(), len(); the descriptor pair is taken from the array's own metadata.
Reads ListArray through element_type(), values(), offsets(), validity(), len(); estimates the nested payload from the child collection it owns.
Reads PrimitiveArray<i32> through values(), validity(), len(), and the is_empty() guard; the entire audit is fixed-width slot arithmetic on the array's own buffers.

checks.description: Detect narration functions that render the shape of an erased input view through the view's own accessors without being hosted on the view.
checks.detected_relation: free narration function -> foreign erased column view
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The narration is a shape reading of the view itself; hosting it elsewhere hides from the view's implementers that a rendering of their type exists.

matches.evidence: Reads each ColumnViewImpl through physical_type(), is_empty(), get(), len(); the rendered line is assembled entirely from the view's own answers.

checks.description: Detect narration functions that render the declared signature of a bound expression through that object's accessors without being hosted on it.
checks.detected_relation: free narration function -> foreign bound-expression object
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The signature line is a projection of the bound expression's own state; a reader hosted elsewhere silently duplicates knowledge of which members carry the declared signature.

matches.evidence: Reads BoundExpression through physical_name(), input_types(), output_type(), output_physical_type(); the narration is a pure signature projection of the bound object.

excluded.reason: Narration helper in the same module, but it reads the erased view through only two members, below the rule's threshold of four distinct readers.
Existing pre-change batch validation reading two members of the view: below threshold and not part of the added reporting layer.
Builder append contract that reads ListScalarRef through three members; the builder legitimately owns appending and the count is below threshold.
Vectorization dispatch reading the erased view through three members; below threshold and part of the existing course contract.
String assembly through the Writer and builder capability wrappers; the wrappers host their own protocol, so the reading is not a summary of a foreign type.
